# Section

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Marks a named document location and optionally renders section content.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`. Extends `ElementBase`.

### `anchorId`

```typescript
anchorId: string
```

The unique anchor identifier. A [`SectionLink`](section-link.md) or [`PageNumberOf`](page-number-of.md) referencing this id resolves to the page this Section rendered on.
